legend: John and his dog Olaf are in a complicated relationship. Therefore, John is trying to run away from his canine companion, but Olaf, surely enough, won't let him.

The road from their house to the park is a straight line. The line consists of N$$$N$$$ points labeled from 1$$$1$$$ to N$$$N$$$. John and Olaf can move from any point to an adjacent one in 1$$$1$$$ minute. Olaf is at point x$$$x$$$ and John at point y$$$y$$$.

John, being very tired, is stumbling. Thus, he moves uniformly at random each minute, either to the left or right. In the meantime, Olaf moves to the right one step each minute. Due to some suspicious law of the universe, John can't move to the right of the park, located at the N$$$N$$$th point. As a result, when he is at the Nth point, John will certainly go to the left during the next minute.

You have to calculate the expected number of minutes after which they will meet. The expected value can be written in the form pq$$$\frac{p}{q} $$$. Please output p⋅q−1(mod1000000007)$$$p \cdot q^{-1} \pmod{1000000007} $$$, where q−1$$$q^{-1}$$$ is the modular inverse of q$$$q$$$.
It is guaranteed that x<y$$$x  \lt  y$$$.
Please note, they do not have to meet at a point, they can meet between points. In that case, we still consider only whole minutes (see the examples).
input: The first line contains three integers N$$$N$$$, x$$$x$$$ and y$$$y$$$.
output: Print a single line, the expected number of minutes until our characters meet.
note: In the first test case, they will always meet in 1 minute because John can only go to the left 1 step and Olaf goes to the right one step.
In the second test case, they meet half-way, the answer is still 1.

legend.ai: John 和他的狗 Olaf 关系复杂。因此，John 正试图逃离他的犬类伙伴，但不出所料，Olaf 不会让他得逞。
他们家到公园的道路是一条直线。这条直线由 N$$$N$$$ 个点组成，点的编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 N$$$N$$$。John 和 Olaf 可以在 1$$$1$$$ 分钟内从任意点移动到相邻点。Olaf 在点 x$$$x$$$，John 在点 y$$$y$$$。
John 非常疲惫，走路踉踉跄跄。因此，他每分钟都会以相同的概率向左或向右移动一步。与此同时，Olaf 每分钟向右移动一步。由于宇宙中某条可疑的定律，John 不能向右越过位于第 N$$$N$$$ 个点的公园。因此，当 John 位于第 N 个点时，他下一分钟一定会向左移动。
你需要计算他们相遇所需时间的期望分钟数。期望值可以写成 pq$$$\frac{p}{q} $$$ 的形式。请输出 p⋅q−1(mod1000000007)$$$p \cdot q^{-1} \pmod{1000000007} $$$，其中 q−1$$$q^{-1}$$$ 是 q$$$q$$$ 的模逆元。
请注意，他们不一定要在某个点相遇，也可以在两个点之间相遇。在这种情况下，我们仍然只考虑完整的分钟（参见样例）。

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 N$$$N$$$、x$$$x$$$ 和 y$$$y$$$。

output.ai: 输出一行，表示两人相遇所需分钟数的期望值。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，他们总会在 1 分钟后相遇，因为 John 只能向左走 1 步，而 Olaf 向右走 1 步。
在第二个测试用例中，他们在中途相遇，答案仍然是 1。
